description: Source of truth for HAMI repos and their integration (PR-target) branches. The orchestrator reads this in Phase 0 RECON before creating any worktree. Executors MUST base worktrees on origin/<integrationBranch> after a fresh fetch, NEVER on the local checkout's current branch (which may be a personal/feature branch like 'sahil' or 'treatment/...'). Update this file when a repo's integration branch changes or a new repo is added.

repos.name: AIClusterApp
repos.stack: Azure App Service (legacy AI cluster host)
repos.notes: Upstream of ClinicalAiServices in some flows. Sahil's rule: zero upstream changes to AIClusterApp.

repos.name: ClientApp
repos.stack: React 18 + Ionic 8 + Vite + TanStack Query + Capacitor

repos.name: ClinicalAIServices
repos.stack: FastAPI + pydantic-ai microservices (AVS, Assessment, Intake Summary, TRLLM, Treatment Summary, LiveKitIntake, LivekitScribe)
repos.notes: Local checkout is often on 'sahil' (personal). origin/HEAD points at origin/main but the team integrates on pg-main. ALWAYS base work on origin/pg-main, not the local branch and not origin/main.

repos.name: PromptFlowApp
repos.stack: Legacy PromptFlow app (being retired in favor of ClinicalAIServices pydantic-ai)
repos.notes: origin/HEAD points at origin/dev and many stray dev-*/main-* branches exist, but the team integrates on pg-main. Local is often on a treatment/... feature branch. ALWAYS base work on origin/pg-main.

conventions.prTarget: Per-repo integrationBranch (see above). There is NO single branch across HAMI — some repos use main, some use pg-main. Do not assume.
conventions.worktreeBase: Always `git fetch origin` then base worktrees on `origin/<integrationBranch>`. Never on the local checkout's current branch.
conventions.sparseCheckout: Scope each executor worktree to its unit's target paths via `git sparse-checkout set --cone`.
